CodeSystem: ACC Patient Occupation CodeSystem

Official URL: https://standards.digital.health.nz/ns/acc-patient-occupation-code Version: 1.0.1
Active as of 2025-09-12 Computable Name: AccPatientOccupationCodeSystem

Codes for classifying patient occupations, drawn from the ACC codeset

This Code system is referenced in the content logical definition of the following value sets:

version: 3; Last updated: 2026-05-07 19:12:16+1200
